subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.**

He did not stop until it was remarked that he was **__speaking at length about trivial things__**.
solution: The correct answer is "rambling."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word** "rambling"** means to speak or write at length in a wandering or aimless manner, often without a clear structure or focus. (भटकते हुए या लक्ष्यहीन तरीके से लंबे समय तक बोलना या लिखना, अक्सर बिना किसी स्पष्ट संरचना या फोकस के) • **Example**: *During the meeting, he began to **ramble**__ on about his weekend adventures, covering everything from mountain hikes to culinary experiments, without ever addressing the main agenda.* • So,** "speaking at length about trivial things" **is called **"rambling."** • Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Twittering: **(used about birds) to make a series of short high sounds. ((चिड़ियों का) चहकना या चहचहाना) • **Writing: **to make words, letters, etc., especially on paper using a pen or pencil. (लिखना (काग़ज़ पर क़लम या पेंसिल से)) • **Littering: **make (a place or area) untidy with rubbish or a large number of objects left lying about. (कचरा फैलाना) 34:Tcae, The correct answer is "Except."
